name: World of ClaudeCraft v0.27.0 版本更新
summary: # World of ClaudeCraft（克劳德争霸） v0.27.0 Release Notes
body:
版本 v0.27.0 发布，包含游戏底层架构迭代与前期核心系统打磨。

# World of ClaudeCraft（克劳德争霸） v0.27.0 Release Notes
**Release:** v0.27.0
**Date:** 2026-07-18
**Previous release:** v0.26.0
v0.27.0 is one of the largest releases to date, spanning 440 commits of class, systems, and content work. The headline themes are a full three-spec 战士 redesign with stances and the Talents 2.0 choice-row engine now covering all nine classes, a complete three-spec 法师 rework introducing the Chronomancy healer role, Professions 2.0 phases 1 through 3 (archetype quests, masterwork procs, deterministic craft quality), the in-game Solana wallet connect flow on desktop and mobile, a live 克劳德币（Claudium） store with USDC payment, the Card Duel PvP minigame, an AAA Welcome Screen and desktop launcher, the custom SFX library now fully active across 130 hand-mastered keys, an enchanting overhaul with Greater-tier enchants consuming Arcane Shards, and configurable movable party and raid frames.
## Highlights
- **战士 Talents 2.0:** The warrior is fully rebuilt as three playable specializations (Battlecraft/Arms, Bloodrush/Fury, Ironguard/Protection), each with a per-spec ability kit, three stances, and a six-tier choice-row talent tree, replacing the old passive tree system now used by all nine classes ([#2041](https://github.com/levy-street/world-of-claudecraft/pull/2041)).
- **法师 Chronomancy healer spec:** The 法师's Arcane specialization is a full healer named Chronomancy, with Temporal Echo (damage-to-healing conversion), the Aether Surge charge engine, the Rewind raid cooldown, Hourglass of Suspension, a combat resurrection, and a Bloodlust-equivalent Temporal Acceleration. Fire and Frost specs receive complete proc-engine reworks with renamed abilities, custom icons, and new finishers (Glacial Spike, Dragon's Breath, Ember Form).
- **Professions 2.0 phases 1 to 3:** The archetype acceptance quest is live (Smith Haldren, 东溪谷（Eastbrook）), pair-based archetype titles replace single-craft practitioner titles, the five-way quality roll is retired in favor of deterministic output plus a signed masterwork proc, combo recipes require the exact active pair, and six new craftable caster-stat gear pieces fill long-empty slots ([#2039](https://github.com/levy-street/world-of-claudecraft/pull/2039), [#2048](https://github.com/levy-street/world-of-claudecraft/pull/2048), [#2080](https://github.com/levy-street/world-of-claudecraft/pull/2080)).
- **In-game Solana wallet connect and 克劳德币（Claudium） store:** Three new in-game wallet connection paths (browser extension, mobile deep link to Phantom/Solflare, Electron handoff to the default browser) plus a USDC purchase rail join the existing SOL and WOC rails in the 克劳德币（Claudium） buy picker. Purchases are fully non-custodial: the server builds the transaction and the player signs with their own wallet ([#2067](https://github.com/levy-street/world-of-claudecraft/pull/2067), [#2002](https://github.com/levy-street/world-of-claudecraft/pull/2002)).
